name: Git object name (40 hex SHA-1 or 64 hex SHA-256)
description: A git object name: the 40 hexadecimal digit SHA-1 name or the 64 hexadecimal digit SHA-256 name of a commit, tree or blob. The 40-hex form has the length and alphabet of bare 40-character keys (the Deepgram API key as contracted; the Cohere key is 40 alphanumerics, a superset alphabet). Git documents these as object names, not as credentials. A git object name in a CI log, commit reference or build metadata is a public reference; whether it sits in a credential-bearing position is a per-input question this sibling does not decide.

sources.supports: Objects can be named by their 40 hexadecimal digit SHA-1 name or 64 hexadecimal digit SHA-256 name.
